name: Innate Pharma S.A.
summary:
Innate Pharma S.A. (IPHA) reported a loss of $0.24 per share on for the second quarter ended June 2026. .

Innate Pharma S.A. is a commercial stage oncology-focused biotech company. It discovers and develops therapeutic antibodies for the treatment of cancer. The company's commercial-stage product includes Lumoxiti. Innate Pharma S.A. is based in Marseille, France.
